hero.title: Tell us what needs to work better.
hero.description: Share the part of your business that feels repetitive, unclear, or harder than it should be. Ridgewell will help you find a practical place to begin.
hero.signalCopy: You do not need a perfect brief. A clear question is enough to start.

details.eyebrow: Start with the context you have
details.title: Bring the question, not a finished solution.
details.description: Tell us a little about your business, the work you want to improve, and what would make the next few months easier. We can take it from there.
details.responseNote: A short description of the friction, goal, or deadline is a helpful place to begin.
